answer: At dawn, auditors sample identities and require each to publish its interaction ledger. An honest agent's ledger is plain timber: a few counterparties, a thin payment trail. A puppet farm fails, its members recycle funds and vouch for each other; one audited ledger reveals the shared operator and sinks the whole cluster, condemning all k aliases. To pass, the farmer needs k separate histories with independent counterparties and capital, costing k times an honest agent's expense. Since draws are unpredictable, no member stays a clean decoy; an honest voyage leaves nothing to punish.
